title: Kagamine Len — Excited For The Journey〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Warmth of a Guiding Hand

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Where'd Rin get to?
She said she wanted to come up with some stage effects together...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Heeey, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh... Welcome back, everyone.
Wait, what?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin, you guys. I didn't know you were with them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sorry!
They said they had something really important to tell us...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Something really important?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's right!
Now that we're all here, let's tell them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is so exciting. I can't wait to hear.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, we'd like to announce...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That we're gonna be on TV!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow...! Another offer for TV! That's incredible!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah, things have going so well lately for you. How many shoots is this now?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, all the hard work you put in is really starting to pay dividends.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah.
It's great to see that you're finding so much success.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, we still have room to do more! After all, our next goal is to do a show at the Butokan!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right! I hope this next program gets even more people interested in MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sounds like you all have plenty of motivation.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But please be careful not to push yourselves too hard with such a busy schedule.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, we will!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, we're going for a shoot and some R&R, so we should have plenty of time to relax.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A shoot and some R&R?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! We're gonna check in at a nearby inn the day before the shoot!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow, that sounds so nice!
What's the inn like?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's called Ryusuiso.
Just give me one second... Ah, this is it. Can you all see?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh my gosh! It has its own hot spring?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds fantastic!
Speaking of which, I remember hearing that inns with hot springs also usually have table tennis. Is that true for this inn...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?! That sounds super fun!
So you could all play against each other if you wanted?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It could be fun to break into pairs and have a doubles tournament.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Who do you think would be the best out of all of us?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: KAITO and Miku seem like they'd make a strong pair. They'd probably be unstoppable once they got on a roll.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have a feeling that you and MEIKO would stun us with some surprising moves, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I've got a pretty good feeling about Rin and me. Right, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! We're not gonna let anyone beat us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Now we're all excited.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I dunno if they have table tennis... But we'll let you all know when we get there.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It shouldn't be a problem. We'd like for you to get the chance to enjoy the trip with us, especially since we're going to such a lovely place.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Woohoo! I can't wait.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, hey!
Since we're going on a trip together, we should grab some outfits for ourselves from the dressing room!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree! That sounds really fun♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, can you girls give us some advice on what we should wear?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sure thing!
You're gonna look absolutely adorable once we're done♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! Then, let's go!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. There they go.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Still, I get why they're so excited.
It's been a while since they last got to stay over somewhere together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Plus, they've been so busy lately.
I mean, they've been working so hard.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I hope this trip ends up being really refreshing for them.
